LESSON: WORD CLASSES: VERBS AND TENSE

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Word classes: Verbs and tense
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Word classes: Verbs and tense, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How did you spend your last holiday?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Word classes: Verbs and tense together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
26

● Communication and collaboration: Learner develops the skill of observing as they engage in signed conversations in pairs using verbs

in various tenses.

● Learning to learn: Learner develops the skill of working collaboratively as they work in groups to search online and offline for

information on verbs and their tenses.

Values:
● Unity: is inculcated as learners collaborate with peers as they work in groups.

● Responsibility: is enhanced as the learner cares for digital devices as they search online for information on verbs and their tenses.

Link to other Subjects

The learner is able to relate the skills used in understanding word classes, specifically verbs and tense, fostering clear and effective

communication in Agriculture and Nutrition
